syllabus.name: HSK 3.0 examination syllabus
syllabus.scope: Complete Level 6 headword coverage (1,800 entries), with two draft contexts per entry; not native-speaker certified.

verification.gloss_source: Original 100 editorial glosses unchanged; remaining 1,700 glosses adapted from the checksum-bound local MDBG CC-CEDICT snapshot, with per-entry attribution and CC BY-SA 4.0 licensing.
verification.sentence_policy: Two examples per headword, conversational then written. All 693 originally flagged examples have new wording; the 69 accepted proposals and final overrides are retained. Every new sentence has editorial provenance, with no inherited corpus IDs or audio.
verification.pinyin_policy: Accepted transcriptions remain exact. New sentences use recorded HSK lexical readings, source-bound target readings and pypinyin-assisted readings for other words; citation third tones, contextual 一/不 changes and neutral joined experiential 过 are retained. No ICU or arbitrary dictionary-longest-phrase fallback is used. Pronunciation remains subject to independent language review.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_policy: No strict Level 1–6 compositional boundary certification. Corpus selections may contain vocabulary beyond Level 6.
verification.taxonomy_policy: Exact unchanged hsk3_topics.json 2.0.0 topics/subtopics and existing POS taxonomy. Added assignments are editorial drafts, using thematic review and existing semantic rules; no earlier-level files modified.
verification.review_limitations: The 69 reviewed replacements were accepted by the owner; 635 further rewrites were requested by the owner and remain newly authored editorial drafts. Structural, source-identity, length and duplication checks do not certify native-speaker review or a strict HSK vocabulary boundary. Other unflagged legacy examples retain their recorded review status.

taxonomy.topic_policy: Use one primary topic per vocabulary sense, secondary topic links only when semantically relevant; optional subtopics require a parent in topic_ids.
taxonomy.pos_policy: primary_pos_id selects the most useful beginner lexical function, not an exclusive analysis; pos_ids includes independently documented secondary roles. Words like 几 (interrogative quantity) are not classifiers merely because they take classifiers after them. Secondary adverbial uses may be beyond beginner level; see pos_note.
